chunks: And whatever in this book is narrated from Ibn Abi Najran, I have transmitted it from my father - may Allah be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran.

key_terms.ابن أبي نجران: Ibn Abi Najran, a prominent narrator of hadith
key_terms.رضي الله عنه: May Allah be pleased with him

ai.seo_question: How is the chain of narration for Ibn Abi Najran's hadiths verified in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This introductory note by Shaykh al-Saduq clarifies the specific transmission chain (isnad) for narrations attributed to Ibn Abi Najran, distinguishing them from other reports. It establishes a direct link from the author to his father, then to Sa'd ibn Abdullah, Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, and finally to Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, ensuring the authenticity of the material in *Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih*. This meticulous documentation reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on verifying the reliability of narrators and the continuity of the chain to preserve the integrity of hadith literature.
